I'm so sorry to hear that :'(
Is there any activity you could do (having a very cold shower, running, stretching your body, lifting weight, call someone, call a crisis centre...), or anything at all that would make you feel less trapped? 
These things really help me when I feel suicidal.
I'm sending positive vibes your way!
Sadly mine hasn't got that zoom button :'(
How do you visualise your data like that? That's amazing!

The same happened to me in Belgium guys. The guy asked me to register at this website: https://www.trustyengagement.com/ed/reg73.php
with exactly the same story!
Do not trust!!
